<function name="GetShootPos" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the shooting position of the NPC, i.e. where their bullets would come from, etc. 

If the NPC does not overwrite this, it will return <page>Entity:GetPos</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The NPC's shooting position.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
